IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Lovick, McDonald, Flannigan, Lantz, Kirby and Moeller

Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing official seals that enable certified documents to be sent electronically.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public seals; and amending RCW 5.44.130.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 5.44.130 and Code 1881 s 434 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A seal of court or public office, when required to any writ,process, or proceeding to authenticate a copy of any record ordocument, may be affixed by making an inked, printed, or embossedimpression directly on the ((paper which)) document and shall be ((as))considered valid ((as if made upon a wafer or on wax)).
